item.title: France Scales Back Solar and Wind Targets Amid Power Surplus
item.description: The French government has marginally reduced its targets for expanding solar and onshore wind capacity as the country faces a power surplus caused by slower-than-expected electrification and declining fossil fuel use. The adjustments are part of France’s long-awaited energy roadmap, which sets production targets for 2030 and 2035 across energy sources including nuclear, hydropower, biofuels, geothermal, solar, and wind. item.title: Vikram Solar Secures ₹3,200 Crore Working Capital Facility From Lender Consortium
item.description: Indian solar module manufacturer Vikram Solar Ltd has now signed a consortium loan agreement to raise working capital facilities of up to ₹3,200 crore, the company said in its recent regulatory filing before the exchanges. The aim is seen as the firm's initiative to strengthen liquidity and refinance existing credit arrangements. item.title: OMC Power, Honda Join To Commission UPS Solution with Repurposed EV Batteries
item.description: OMC Power and Honda have partnered to commission a distributed renewable energy–based UPS solution integrating repurposed electric vehicle (EV) batteries for stationary storage. item.title: Insolation Energy Q3 Revenue Jumps 77%, 9M FY26 Up 44% on Capacity Ramp-Up
item.description: Jaipur-based Insolation Energy Limited, in its unaudited financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended FY26, reported revenue of ₹1,352 Cr for 9M FY26, registering 44% year-on-year (YoY) growth. In a press release, the company attributed this growth to a scale-up in capacity, supported by an expanding distribution footprint in the utility segment.
